Both reply endpoints correctly 401/403 for anonymous and tenant admin. Frontend landing /#pricing on India · ₹ toggle renders exactly Free Trial + Monthly ₹1,455 + 3-Month ₹4,365 + BEST VALUE Annual ₹16,000 (1 month free) + Multi-Branch; no '6-Month' text anywhere. Super-Admin → /super-admin?tab=mira-leads → Reply Inbox toggle expands and reply-row-qa-reply-test1 shows the 'demo invite sent' badge; reply-toggle expands the reply text. Tenant settings /settings#subscription (after PIN 4321 + dismissing What's New + passkey 'Not now') renders monthly/quarter/annual/2-Branch Annual cards (no plan-half_year). Selecting [data-testid=plan-annual] reveals [data-testid=upgrade-quote] with amount-due '= ₹6,360.66 + GST' and pay button 'Upgrade — pay ₹7,506'; selecting plan-monthly hides the upgrade panel and button reads 'Pay ₹1,717'. Pay button never clicked. send-demo-reply never called.

Testing needs 3 dismiss loops to reach /settings — real users on shared devices will hit the same friction. Consider suppressing the passkey nudge on the shared-device PIN screen and deferring What's New until after Owner PIN unlock.

critical_code_review_comments: _upgrade_quote clamps credit to new_price - 1 so amount_due is always ≥ ₹1 — this is correct and matches Razorpay INR min. Good.
_upgrade_quote does not check whether current plan is INR when new is USD — but the currency guard higher up (cur.currency != new.currency) already returns ineligible, so it's safe. Verified.

server.py _plans_v2_monthly() hides 6-month plans via a startup migration; if a HQ admin ever restores one via /super-admin/plans/{key}/restore, the migration only fires once per day (based on plans-v2-monthly key) — restored plan stays visible until next monthly run. If that isn't intended, add a stronger constant-time filter in visible_plans() to permanently exclude those 6 keys.
